spans.title: Four Wild Horses
spans.blurb: Plotting revenge on the road, a lady's maid collides with the handsome gentleman hunting for her mistress's address, and decides wild horses will not drag it from her.
spans.brokenNote: The passage stops mid-sentence in the closing line of dialogue, leaving her final speech unfinished.

spans.title: The Cup of Gyptis
spans.blurb: A Greek ship led by a priestess searches a coastline for an empty harbour, and finds a king's feast where a princess must choose her husband by handing a cup.

spans.title: The Boy and the Bear
spans.blurb: Ice-bound on a polar expedition, a fearless midshipman slips off the ship at midnight with one rusty musket, determined to bring home a bear's skin for his father.

spans.title: The Blind Eye
spans.blurb: Ships run aground, pilots lose their nerve, and a distant admiral signals retreat. Amid the smoke, a one-eyed commander raises a telescope and chooses not to see.

books.pairNote: A boyhood bear hunt on the ice and a fleet battle decades later; they share nothing but the man.

spans.title: A Long Walk in Tight Boots
spans.blurb: Cowboys who hate walking jog miles through the dark in tight boots, trailing a rival's horse to steal a glimpse of his secret trick-riding stunt.

spans.title: Pup Night
spans.blurb: On the second night of term, hazers corner a sobbing younger boy in the dark road, and a newcomer decides this has gone far enough.

spans.title: The Door in the Tree
spans.blurb: A cheerfully useless guide gets two children lost beneath twisted grey trees, where they find a small rusted door set into the biggest trunk of all.

spans.title: The Invention of the Navy
spans.blurb: A gloriously muddled history lesson in which King Arthur invents conferences, Alfred builds longer ships than the Danes, and the defeated are made romantic by decree.

spans.title: Wrong but Wromantic
spans.blurb: The Civil War explained at last: Cavaliers are Wrong but Wromantic, Roundheads Right but Repulsive, and under these circumstances war is inevitable.

books.pairNote: Separate centuries and separate jokes in the same parody register; neither dulls the other.

spans.title: Awake in the Dark
spans.blurb: A famous barrister wakes in pitch dark in a bunk that is not his bed, certain of yesterday's appointments and nothing else, least of all where he is.
